items.title: llama.cpp reaches version 1.0.0
items.summary: Hugging Face's Julien Chaumond announced the 1.0.0 tag for llama.cpp, the local inference runtime. The post links no release notes or changelog, so what changed in 1.0 is unconfirmed.

doubt.pushback: Replies are mostly hardware jokes and congratulations; one asks what is new and nobody answers with release notes.

reception.summary: Repliers cheered and listed hardware they run it on; a few described stable API and GGUF ecosystem benefits without citing release notes, and none reported a regression.

items.title: Pirate Face revamps its open-weight model directory with model trees
items.summary: Pirate Face's models page now groups open-weight models into lineage trees (base models and their finetunes) instead of a flat directory, to make finding a suitable model easier.
